learning_outcomes.text: After successful completion of this module, students are able to design the software architecture of such systems with suitable components and communication structures and implement it independently within an extensive project.

syllabus_topics: Typical software components like processes and threads and their application
Various services like Pipes, SharedMemory, Semaphore, or MessageQueues
Typical design patterns of software architectures in mechatronic systems: analysis, comparison, typical design errors
Realization of an example project from automotive or aerospace with multisystem and multitasking using C++ and Linux operating system
Current topics from automation technology (production automation and control technology)
Networking of various systems and their communication structures
Requirements, solution strategies, and implementation possibilities through examples
assessment_rules: The examination performance is taken in two individual examinations (MECB721 and MECB722). The weighting is according to ECTS, though no specific percentages are given. For MECB721, students can choose between a graded written exam (60 min), a graded oral exam (20 min), or a graded presentation (20 min). For MECB722, students can choose between a graded written exam (60 min), a written elaboration within 3 months, or a graded presentation (20 min). Participation and collaboration in the exercises, as well as the successful completion of tasks, are prerequisites for admission to the examination (XP).
institution: Hochschule Karlsruhe - Technik Und Wirtschaft — Mechatronik (B.Eng.)
